# Helvety

> Swiss-built helvety.com web apps, crisp legal pages, and Store links for related Helvety products. MIT-licensed source for this monorepo, minimal marketing fluff.

## Canonical URLs
- [Home](https://helvety.com): Main landing page
- [Privacy Policy](https://helvety.com/privacy): Current privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://helvety.com/terms): Terms governing service use
- [Impressum](https://helvety.com/impressum): Legal company information

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public pages are intended to be indexable by search and AI crawlers.
- Private app routes are not intended as search index targets and use noindex and auth-gated controls.

## Related apps and tools
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Specs plus .sppkg / ZIP artifacts straight from the catalog
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): SPFx header control for tenant-wide site discovery
- [Power Automate: editor preference](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-automate-editor-preference): Edge/Chrome MV3 extension for classic vs new designer on flow/run links, optional v3survey on the Feedback tab (ignore by default), pause without uninstalling
- [Helvety Screen Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-screen-tools): WinUI capture + Live Draw overlay for Windows
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Thumbnail-first PDF workbench with local processing where supported
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler): In-browser 2×/4× or target-size upscaler with on-device AI (Real-ESRGAN via WebGPU/WASM) and a canvas-resample fallback, no image upload to Helvety servers
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Encrypted address book with export tooling
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Encrypted quick notes in Personal / Work / Other lanes
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Encrypted kanban with immutable Helvety stages

## Source
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Open-source monorepo for helvety.com web applications and shared packages (MIT)
